numbering.migration_rule: Archive the current 21-50 set first. If Test 21 is explicitly protected in the repository, use 22-51 instead and update every generated artifact consistently.

experiments.title: Boardroom Editorial
experiments.hypothesis: A premium editorial briefing can make SpeakKai feel authoritative without becoming cold or generic.
experiments.layout_archetype: Asymmetric broadsheet: oversized statement, cropped portrait column, compact program brief and proof rail.
experiments.visual_language: Executive magazine, financial editorial, disciplined white space, fine rules, one sharp yellow accent.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Large vertical crop with a narrow editorial caption and subtle paper-grain mask.
experiments.interaction_model: Three briefing tabs switch Programs, Evidence, and Partnership without leaving the viewport.
experiments.motion_language: Quiet rule draws, masked image reveal, precise 180–280 ms tab transitions.
experiments.palette_direction: Ink navy, warm white, muted steel, bright SpeakKai yellow.
experiments.typography_direction: High-contrast editorial serif paired with a technical grotesk.
tool_routes: Canva only for optional paper texture
experiments.avoid: Do not reproduce the screenshot's three-column portrait/headline/card layout.

experiments.title: Swiss Evidence Grid
experiments.hypothesis: A rigorous evidence-first grid can reduce uncertainty and make outcomes easy to scan.
experiments.layout_archetype: Twelve-column modular grid with a small identity block, one large question, and evidence tiles of unequal scale.
experiments.visual_language: International Swiss style, high alignment, numerals, restrained icons, no decorative gradients.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Circular or square monochrome headshot used as an identity seal rather than a hero.
experiments.interaction_model: Evidence tiles expand in place on click/focus; one tile can be open at a time.
experiments.motion_language: Grid snapping, number count-up only when factual, subtle cross-axis shifts.
experiments.palette_direction: White, navy-black, cool gray, yellow marker.
experiments.typography_direction: Neutral Swiss grotesk with tabular numerals.
tool_routes: Framer Motion or GSAP only if already installed
experiments.avoid: No dashboard clichés, fake metrics, or decorative charts.

experiments.title: Annual Report Live
experiments.hypothesis: An annual-report metaphor can frame SpeakKai as a mature practice with a clear method and track record.
experiments.layout_archetype: Live report cover with a CEO-letter portrait, a program ring, a process timeline, and a compact evidence drawer.
experiments.visual_language: Annual report, investor presentation, data editorial, transparent provenance labels.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Half-tone or duotone portrait inside a formal letterhead frame.
experiments.interaction_model: Hover/focus on report sections previews a concise summary; click opens a side sheet.
experiments.motion_language: Page-number transitions, chart strokes, controlled vertical wipes.
experiments.palette_direction: Midnight blue, off-white, cobalt, restrained yellow.
experiments.typography_direction: Corporate humanist sans with compact serif annotations.
tool_routes: Remotion only for an optional report-opening loop
experiments.avoid: Do not invent performance numbers or use stock-market visual language.

experiments.title: Executive Keynote
experiments.hypothesis: A homepage that behaves like a polished keynote can demonstrate presentation expertise through the interface itself.
experiments.layout_archetype: One dominant slide at a time with a visible four-chapter rail: Why, Programs, Proof, Contact.
experiments.visual_language: Premium keynote, cinematic stage lighting, large type, minimal chrome.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Full-height cutout entering from the edge, with controlled rim-light treatment.
experiments.interaction_model: Click, keyboard arrows, or chapter rail swaps the in-viewport slide state.
experiments.motion_language: Presentation-grade text choreography, mask reveals, no continuous looping.
experiments.palette_direction: Dark navy stage, soft spotlight, white, yellow cue light.
experiments.typography_direction: Large geometric sans with condensed metadata.
tool_routes: HyperFrames or Remotion for motion studies
experiments.avoid: Do not embed a rendered video as the whole website; the content must remain accessible and interactive.

experiments.title: Parent Decision Matrix
experiments.hypothesis: Starting from a parent's concern can make the next step feel personal and concrete.
experiments.layout_archetype: Four-quadrant concern matrix with a portrait anchor and a dynamic recommendation panel.
experiments.visual_language: Calm advisory service, clean decision support, approachable rather than clinical.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Friendly three-quarter portrait in a soft rounded frame; no fake advisor badge.
experiments.interaction_model: Choose Confidence, Structure, Competition, or Presentation; content and CTA adapt instantly.
experiments.motion_language: Panel morph, soft highlight travel, concise content crossfade.
experiments.palette_direction: Ice blue, navy, warm white, yellow confirmation.
experiments.typography_direction: Warm humanist sans with clear hierarchy.
tool_routes: No external asset required beyond portrait
experiments.avoid: Do not diagnose students or promise guaranteed outcomes.

experiments.title: Institutional Blueprint
experiments.hypothesis: A blueprint interface can show how programs are assembled, customized, and delivered.
experiments.layout_archetype: Architectural plan with labeled zones for audience, format, curriculum, delivery, and outcomes.
experiments.visual_language: Blueprint/technical plan with precise annotations and a warm human portrait counterpoint.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait pinned like a project lead photo on the plan.
experiments.interaction_model: Click blueprint zones to reveal implementation details in a compact inspector.
experiments.motion_language: Line drawing, blueprint callouts, measured zoom without freeform panning.
experiments.palette_direction: Deep blueprint blue, cream linework, yellow measurement marks.
experiments.typography_direction: Technical mono labels plus a readable sans.
experiments.avoid: Do not make it look like engineering software or hide the human teaching story.

experiments.title: Coaching Atelier
experiments.hypothesis: A refined atelier metaphor can position coaching as bespoke craft rather than a commodity lesson.
experiments.layout_archetype: Editorial salon: framed portrait, one elegant thesis, three service swatches, discreet proof drawer.
experiments.visual_language: Luxury editorial, warm paper, tailored details, no generic gold-on-black excess.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Formal portrait with subtle fabric or deckled-paper edge treatment.
experiments.interaction_model: Service swatches reveal bespoke coaching pathways and examples.
experiments.motion_language: Slow paper lift, line reveal, gentle focus shifts.
experiments.palette_direction: Ivory, midnight, muted cobalt, restrained brass-yellow.
experiments.typography_direction: Elegant serif with a clean contemporary sans.
tool_routes: Canva for texture composite if needed
experiments.avoid: No champagne-luxury clichés, fake scarcity, or vague prestige copy.

experiments.title: Case Study Wall
experiments.hypothesis: Real, concise transformation stories can build more trust than a conventional credentials list.
experiments.layout_archetype: Layered case cards with a coach annotation column and a fixed evidence/CTA spine.
experiments.visual_language: Museum case-study wall, documentary labels, authentic photography.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Coach portrait appears as an annotator, not the center of every card.
experiments.interaction_model: Select a case card to reveal Goal → Practice → Change → Next step.
experiments.motion_language: Card lift, annotation underline, before/after wipe where real assets exist.
experiments.palette_direction: Gallery white, charcoal, navy labels, yellow annotation.
experiments.typography_direction: Museum editorial sans with compact captions.
experiments.avoid: Use only approved, factual, privacy-safe student stories.

experiments.title: Documentary Press Room
experiments.hypothesis: A documentary contact-sheet can make the brand feel real, human, and active.
experiments.layout_archetype: Full-viewport photo contact sheet with a central story caption and a vertical evidence ticker.
experiments.visual_language: Documentary photography, press captions, film contact marks, restrained grain.
experiments.portrait_treatment: One authentic Coach Kai image among real event/classroom frames; not a studio-only hero.
experiments.interaction_model: Focus/click a frame to enlarge it and reveal one factual story sentence.
experiments.motion_language: Contact-sheet focus, film-gate slide, caption type-on kept brief.
experiments.palette_direction: Black, warm white, documentary blue, yellow timestamp.
experiments.typography_direction: Editorial sans with monospaced captions.
tool_routes: Canva for contact sheet if needed
experiments.avoid: No fake film borders over low-quality or unrelated stock images.

experiments.title: Corporate Motion Identity
experiments.hypothesis: A controlled motion identity can demonstrate speaking energy while retaining executive credibility.
experiments.layout_archetype: Full-screen typographic identity system with portrait slices, moving rule architecture, and a fixed action dock.
experiments.visual_language: Broadcast brand package, conference opener, clean geometric motion.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait divided into crisp masked slices that align into one complete image.
experiments.interaction_model: Hover/focus over Speaking, Debate, TEDx, or Business shifts the identity composition and copy.
experiments.motion_language: Kinetic rules, masked portrait assembly, finite loops only.
experiments.palette_direction: Royal blue, navy, white, high-energy yellow.
experiments.typography_direction: Condensed display sans plus neutral interface sans.
tool_routes: HyperFrames/Remotion for motion study or export
experiments.avoid: Do not let motion obscure the value proposition or run infinitely at full intensity.

experiments.title: Skill Galaxy
experiments.hypothesis: A spatial skill universe can make communication growth feel explorable and aspirational.
experiments.layout_archetype: Coach Kai at the center with orbiting skill worlds and a lower mission dock.
experiments.visual_language: Polished educational sci-fi, luminous orbits, not childish outer-space clip art.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Clean cutout portrait with soft edge light at the galaxy center.
experiments.interaction_model: Click/focus orbiting worlds for Confidence, Structure, Debate, Performance, and Leadership.
experiments.motion_language: Slow finite orbital cycles, focus zoom, particle motion reduced or removed under reduced-motion.
experiments.palette_direction: Deep space navy, electric blue, warm yellow stars, soft white.
experiments.typography_direction: Rounded futuristic sans with a highly readable body face.
tool_routes: ChatGPT image generation only for abstract space texture
experiments.avoid: No tiny unreadable orbit labels or constant high-speed rotation.

experiments.title: Stage Quest
experiments.hypothesis: A stage-quest metaphor can make practice feel like progression rather than correction.
experiments.layout_archetype: Isometric or layered stage with four visible levels and a coach guide panel.
experiments.visual_language: Premium game-map, stage lights, achievement path, mature enough for teens.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Coach Kai as a guide card or full-body cutout beside the level path.
experiments.interaction_model: Select Level 1–4 to reveal goals, practice, challenge, and showcase.
experiments.motion_language: Spotlight travel, path illumination, badge reveal, no confetti overload.
experiments.palette_direction: Dark stage navy, magenta/blue light accents, SpeakKai yellow.
experiments.typography_direction: Bold game-title display with neutral interface copy.
tool_routes: Canva or image generation for stage props
experiments.avoid: Do not gamify with fake scores, coins, streaks, or pressure mechanics.

experiments.title: Comic Speech Lab
experiments.hypothesis: Comic storytelling can demonstrate voice, expression, and structure in a memorable way.
experiments.layout_archetype: Six unequal comic panels that together form one complete 16:9 story.
experiments.visual_language: Contemporary graphic novel, halftone sparingly, energetic speech bubbles.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Photo-based Coach Kai cutout integrated into one or two illustrated panels.
experiments.interaction_model: Panels expand slightly and reveal mini lessons; keyboard order follows story order.
experiments.motion_language: Panel punch-in, speech bubble pop, drawn emphasis lines.
experiments.palette_direction: Navy, cream, coral, cyan, yellow accent.
experiments.typography_direction: Expressive display lettering plus accessible sans; no all-caps paragraphs.
tool_routes: ChatGPT image generation for non-person decorative art
experiments.avoid: Do not make it look preschool-level or bury text inside inaccessible raster images.

experiments.title: Kinetic Type Jam
experiments.hypothesis: The interface can teach vocal delivery by letting typography visibly respond to speaking concepts.
experiments.layout_archetype: Giant live typography field with four control words: Power, Pitch, Pace, Pause.
experiments.visual_language: Motion-graphic title sequence, typographic playground, clean and legible.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait appears as a masked silhouette or cropped edge witness, not the main block.
experiments.interaction_model: Selecting each P changes type scale, rhythm, spacing, and supporting message.
experiments.motion_language: Variable-font or transform choreography; deterministic and reduced-motion safe.
experiments.palette_direction: Black/navy canvas with white type and one changing accent anchored by yellow.
experiments.typography_direction: Variable display sans with a stable UI sans.
experiments.avoid: Do not animate every word simultaneously or compromise readability.

experiments.title: Speaking Game HUD
experiments.hypothesis: A skill HUD can make complex speaking abilities feel tangible without pretending to measure the student.
experiments.layout_archetype: Futuristic HUD around a portrait with four non-numeric skill modules and a mission card.
experiments.visual_language: Competitive game interface, crisp lines, mature esports polish.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait inside a dynamic player-card frame with no fake ranking.
experiments.interaction_model: Choose a skill module to see one practice mission and one outcome.
experiments.motion_language: HUD scan, reticle shift, module lock-on, gentle idle only.
experiments.palette_direction: Near-black navy, electric cyan, yellow, white.
experiments.typography_direction: Technical display face plus readable sans.
experiments.avoid: No fake performance scores, leaderboards, or manipulative game mechanics.

experiments.title: Sticker Cutout Studio
experiments.hypothesis: A creator-style cutout composition can make Coach Kai feel approachable and socially current.
experiments.layout_archetype: Large portrait cutout surrounded by draggable but bounded stickers, labels, and mini cards.
experiments.visual_language: High-energy creator thumbnail meets polished sticker sheet.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Accurate clean cutout with bold outline and optional duplicated shadow layer.
experiments.interaction_model: Drag decorative stickers; click functional stickers to reveal programs and proof.
experiments.motion_language: Springy but controlled sticker entrance, tilt on hover, no physics chaos.
experiments.palette_direction: Bright yellow, royal blue, coral, white, charcoal.
experiments.typography_direction: Bold creator display paired with a neutral rounded sans.
tool_routes: ChatGPT image generation for abstract stickers
experiments.avoid: Do not change facial features, make the portrait cartoonishly inaccurate, or let drag interactions block keyboard access.

experiments.title: Classroom Desk World
experiments.hypothesis: A top-down desk world can explain the coaching process through familiar objects.
experiments.layout_archetype: Top-down desk scene: notebook, microphone, cue cards, trophy, calendar, and portrait polaroid.
experiments.visual_language: Warm tactile tabletop, crafted object illustration, real photo details.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait as a polaroid or ID card placed naturally on the desk.
experiments.interaction_model: Each object maps to a content category; selecting it opens a note card within the desk.
experiments.motion_language: Object nudge, paper slide, pen underline, subtle shadow response.
experiments.palette_direction: Warm wood/cream, navy stationery, yellow sticky note, cobalt ink.
experiments.typography_direction: Friendly sans plus hand-drawn annotation used sparingly.
experiments.avoid: Do not use a cluttered stock desk photo with unreadable hotspots.

experiments.title: Rhythm & Voice Visualizer
experiments.hypothesis: A visual rhythm system can make vocal delivery feel physical and understandable.
experiments.layout_archetype: Portrait on one edge, a large waveform/rhythm field, and a compact control dock.
experiments.visual_language: Music visualizer meets speech coaching, precise rather than nightclub-like.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Side-profile or three-quarter portrait integrated into waveform contours.
experiments.interaction_model: Select Pace, Pause, Emphasis, or Emotion to change the visualization and coaching prompt.
experiments.motion_language: Deterministic waveform pulses and marker sweeps; optional sound is explicit and off by default.
experiments.palette_direction: Midnight, electric blue, lavender, yellow cue markers.
experiments.typography_direction: Modern grotesk with monospaced timing labels.
tool_routes: HyperFrames for a visualizer study or pre-rendered loop
Suno only for optional owned instrumental demo
Web Audio only after explicit user action
experiments.avoid: No autoplay sound, no seizure-risk strobing, and no fake live microphone analysis.

experiments.title: Transformation Flipbook
experiments.hypothesis: A flipbook sequence can make practice and growth feel concrete while avoiding miracle-transformation claims.
experiments.layout_archetype: Central flipbook/cards with four stages: Unsure, Structured, Practiced, Ready; portrait and CTA frame the sequence.
experiments.visual_language: Editorial flipbook, frame-by-frame growth, hand-marked coaching notes.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait appears as the coach observing/annotating the frames.
experiments.interaction_model: Drag a timeline or use arrows to move through the four stages.
experiments.motion_language: Page flip, pose/copy transitions, annotation reveal.
experiments.palette_direction: Cream, navy, sky blue, coral note, yellow marker.
experiments.typography_direction: Editorial sans with handwritten coaching notes.
experiments.avoid: Do not imply guaranteed personality change or use fake before/after testimonials.

experiments.title: Motion Poster Festival
experiments.hypothesis: A motion-poster homepage can make speaking feel like a cultural event rather than a remedial class.
experiments.layout_archetype: A full-bleed poster with modular type blocks, portrait crop, event-like program strips, and one action stamp.
experiments.visual_language: Contemporary festival poster, kinetic graphic design, bold but intentional.
experiments.portrait_treatment: High-contrast portrait crop integrated behind and in front of type layers.
experiments.interaction_model: Hover/focus/click rearranges poster modules into Student, Parent, or School information states.
experiments.motion_language: Poster blocks slide, type masks, finite composition shuffle.
experiments.palette_direction: Electric royal blue, yellow, off-white, optional coral.
experiments.typography_direction: Oversized condensed display with compact readable labels.
experiments.avoid: Do not sacrifice legibility for poster aesthetics.

experiments.title: Spatial Glass Canvas
experiments.hypothesis: A restrained spatial interface can feel contemporary while keeping trust and clarity central.
experiments.layout_archetype: Three floating translucent planes: Identity, Programs, Evidence, with a grounded CTA dock.
experiments.visual_language: Spatial computing, frosted depth, calm gradients, precise lighting.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait behind one translucent pane with natural skin preserved.
experiments.interaction_model: Select a plane to bring it forward; all content remains keyboard reachable.
experiments.motion_language: Depth shift, focus blur change, spring damping kept subtle.
experiments.palette_direction: Ice blue, translucent white, navy, warm yellow focus ring.
experiments.typography_direction: Contemporary neo-grotesk with spacious tracking.
experiments.avoid: No illegible glassmorphism, excessive blur, or weak contrast.

experiments.title: Neo-Brutalist Studio
experiments.hypothesis: A bold neo-brutalist interface can communicate confidence, directness, and personality.
experiments.layout_archetype: Hard-edged blocks, oversized headline, portrait stamp, visible utility controls, asymmetrical grid.
experiments.visual_language: Neo-brutalism refined by strong spacing and accessible type.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Posterized or monochrome portrait stamp with accurate facial structure.
experiments.interaction_model: Big labeled blocks open as in-place panels; visible interaction affordances.
experiments.motion_language: Hard cuts, snap transitions, deliberate shake only on user action.
experiments.palette_direction: Black, white, royal blue, bright yellow, optional acid green only if balanced.
experiments.typography_direction: Heavy grotesk with monospaced utility text.
tool_routes: Canva for posterized portrait if needed
experiments.avoid: Do not confuse brutalism with careless spacing or inaccessible contrast.

experiments.title: 3D Card Architecture
experiments.hypothesis: A controlled 3D card architecture can show multiple offerings while preserving one clear hierarchy.
experiments.layout_archetype: Perspective deck of four program cards, portrait as the stabilizing front plane, CTA fixed to horizon.
experiments.visual_language: Premium 3D interface, matte materials, architectural depth.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait on the front card with depth-separated foreground and background.
experiments.interaction_model: Keyboard/click rotates the card deck; each card exposes a concise program proposition.
experiments.motion_language: Perspective rotation, depth easing, no free spinning.
experiments.palette_direction: Deep navy, stone white, cobalt, yellow edge light.
experiments.typography_direction: Architectural sans with compact labels.
tool_routes: CSS 3D transforms or Three.js only if already justified
experiments.avoid: Do not add heavy WebGL if CSS 3D is sufficient.

experiments.title: Lens Portal
experiments.hypothesis: A single visual lens can unify identity, services, and outcomes in a memorable but simple interface.
experiments.layout_archetype: Large circular/elliptical lens with portrait inside; contextual content wraps the perimeter.
experiments.visual_language: Optical interface, crisp rings, modern editorial science.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait framed through a lens with subtle magnification zones, never face distortion.
experiments.interaction_model: Move or select the lens to focus on Coach, Programs, Students, or Partnerships.
experiments.motion_language: Lens glide, ring pulse, focus transition.
experiments.palette_direction: Soft white, navy, spectral blue, yellow focal mark.
experiments.typography_direction: Clean geometric sans with optical labels.
tool_routes: Image generation only for abstract refraction texture
experiments.avoid: No facial warping, gimmicky cursor chasing, or low-contrast refraction.

experiments.title: Quiet Monochrome
experiments.hypothesis: Extreme restraint can communicate confidence and trust when the copy and portrait are strong enough.
experiments.layout_archetype: One portrait, one statement, three tiny proof anchors, one CTA; disclosure appears in a precise side rail.
experiments.visual_language: Museum minimalism, monochrome photography, one yellow interaction accent.
experiments.portrait_treatment: High-quality monochrome portrait with natural texture and generous breathing room.
experiments.interaction_model: Three discreet anchors reveal Method, Experience, and Programs in the side rail.
experiments.motion_language: Opacity, line draw, and one controlled portrait crop shift.
experiments.palette_direction: Warm white, black/navy, gray, yellow.
experiments.typography_direction: Elegant modern serif or neutral sans, very large and sparse.
tool_routes: Canva for monochrome treatment if original asset needs it
experiments.avoid: Do not confuse minimalism with missing information or tiny text.

experiments.title: SpeakKai OS
experiments.hypothesis: An operating-system metaphor can organize many audiences and services without scrolling.
experiments.layout_archetype: Desktop canvas with four purposeful windows: Coach, Programs, Proof, Contact.
experiments.visual_language: Contemporary desktop OS, friendly productivity system, polished not retro parody.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait in the Coach window with contextual metadata and no fake account data.
experiments.interaction_model: Windows can focus, minimize, and snap; keyboard order remains logical.
experiments.motion_language: Window open/snap, dock highlight, restrained shadow depth.
experiments.palette_direction: Soft blue desktop, white windows, navy text, yellow active state.
experiments.typography_direction: Modern UI sans with compact mono labels.
experiments.avoid: Do not make windows draggable off-screen or require desktop metaphors on mobile.

experiments.title: Cinematic Hotspot Portrait
experiments.hypothesis: One powerful image with well-designed hotspots can feel emotional while keeping the interface simple.
experiments.layout_archetype: Full-bleed portrait or speaking image with five anchored hotspots and a fixed brand/CTA strip.
experiments.visual_language: Cinematic editorial, strong photography, restrained overlays.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Use the highest-resolution authentic photo; preserve face and skin, crop for text-safe zones.
experiments.interaction_model: Hotspots reveal concise cards for Coach, Method, Programs, Results, and Contact.
experiments.motion_language: Focus pull, card reveal, spotlight drift; no camera-motion simulation that causes nausea.
experiments.palette_direction: Photo-led with navy/black overlays and yellow hotspot markers.
experiments.typography_direction: Cinematic sans with clear compact cards.
experiments.avoid: Do not use hover-only hotspots or cover the face with labels.

experiments.title: Fluid Typography Field
experiments.hypothesis: Responsive typography can embody clarity, confidence, and adaptability without relying on complex illustration.
experiments.layout_archetype: A fluid headline occupies most of the canvas; portrait and information modules move around its changing negative space.
experiments.visual_language: Contemporary variable-type art direction, minimal shapes, high responsiveness.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait crop changes between edge, inset, and cutout states without altering the face.
experiments.interaction_model: Audience controls morph the headline and rearrange the information field.
experiments.motion_language: Variable font axes, smooth reflow, shape morphs with reduced-motion static states.
experiments.palette_direction: Royal blue/white with yellow and one rotating secondary accent.
experiments.typography_direction: Variable display family plus stable body font.
tool_routes: CSS variable fonts and container queries
experiments.avoid: Do not make essential meaning depend on an unsupported variable-font effect.

experiments.title: Living Network Map
experiments.hypothesis: A network map can show how audiences, skills, formats, and outcomes connect across SpeakKai's work.
experiments.layout_archetype: Central SpeakKai node with four clusters: Audiences, Skills, Programs, Outcomes; portrait integrated as the human core.
experiments.visual_language: Data-informed network visualization, elegant nodes, no fake analytics.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Small high-quality portrait at the central human node.
experiments.interaction_model: Select a node to trace a real pathway, such as Student → Debate → Small Group → Confidence.
experiments.motion_language: Path tracing, node focus, cluster breathing kept subtle and finite.
experiments.palette_direction: Light canvas, navy nodes, cobalt links, yellow active path.
experiments.typography_direction: Technical but warm sans with clear node labels.
tool_routes: Avoid heavy graph libraries unless needed
experiments.avoid: Do not imply quantitative relationships that are not real.

experiments.title: Adaptive Audience Prism
experiments.hypothesis: One strong brand canvas can adapt its evidence, tone, and CTA to parents, students, and customers without becoming generic.
experiments.layout_archetype: A central portrait/prism with three audience faces; selecting one transforms the same single-screen composition.
experiments.visual_language: Signature SpeakKai future-facing identity, geometric light, human portrait, clear audience modes.
experiments.portrait_treatment: Portrait remains constant while framing, crop, and supporting visuals adapt per audience.
experiments.interaction_model: Parent, Student, and School/Customer mode controls; state is shareable via URL parameter.
experiments.motion_language: Prism rotation, palette shift, content re-layout, all under one second and reduced-motion safe.
experiments.palette_direction: Core navy/yellow with distinct but harmonious secondary colors per audience.
experiments.typography_direction: One strong brand display system with adaptive supporting type scales.
tool_routes: GSAP/Framer Motion or CSS for runtime
experiments.avoid: Do not merely recolor identical content; each audience mode must change the argument, proof, and CTA.
